testcase.name: a Cathedral headshot is one shot and a body shot is two
a body shot at the muzzle does exactly the weapon's damage
a kill reaches the feed with the headshot and friendly-fire flags set
a team kill and a self kill credit nobody
nothing is applied for a missing target, a dead one, or zero damage
a full-arena shot deals clearly less damage than a point-blank one
death sets the respawn timer, counts the death, and credits the killer once
damage with no attacker still works, for Phase 5 hazards
every applied hit is queued once and drains once
a headshot is worth double at every range
friendly fire and self-damage are on, and Neutral fights everyone
